steps.hint: Click the ground to walk. Right-drag rotates the camera; scroll to zoom.
steps.voice: Nesh: Over here. Follow my lantern.

steps.objective: Talk to Caldus in the boathouse
steps.hint: Click Caldus. He has the supplies for the climb.
steps.voice: Caldus: That boat will follow our light. There isn't a light.

steps.hint: Click the chart beside Caldus. Your quest log keeps the current instruction.
steps.voice: Nesh: Reeds for the shutters. Quartz for the lantern. The shore kept enough.

steps.hint: Press Tab or click Map. The gold marker matches the lantern in the world.
Click the exposed Reed patch. Harvesting repeats and stops at three.
Your Pickaxe is in your pack. Minerals require the right tool.

steps.objective: Store the 3 Reed in the keeper's cache
steps.hint: Click the cache. Select Reed in your pack, then Deposit.
steps.voice: Nesh: The lantern upstairs uses the same cache seal. Leave the repair parts here.

steps.hint: Deposit the Quartz too. Both caches share the same contents.
Take the plank from the cache's crafting supplies.
Take the cloth for your torch.
The Hatchet is a tool. Crafting uses the materials but keeps the tool.
Open Manufacturing at the bench: 1 Wood Plank + 1 Cloth Roll, with a Hatchet.
steps.voice: Nesh: Plank, cloth and a steady hand. I'll help you with the first one.

steps.hint: Open Inventory and equip the Sword before approaching the boar.
steps.voice: Nesh: Shield up. I'll keep him clear.

steps.hint: Equip the Shield in your other hand. Attacks and defense happen automatically.
Click the boar to attack. Click open ground to retreat. Nesh can help you recover.
Take the Raw Meat from the bag. Auto-gather also completes this step.
Follow the path up to Nesh's lantern.
steps.voice: Nesh: Eat. You did the hard part.

steps.objective: Recover your food to 35 or more
steps.hint: Open Inventory and eat Bread. Positive food supports health and ether recovery.

steps.objective: Spend a pickpoint on Matter or Carry
steps.hint: Open Statistics. Matter increases health; Carry increases pack capacity. Either advances.
steps.voice: Nesh: Decide what will help you on the road. Then we'll finish the climb.

steps.objective: Withdraw your 3 Reed from the upper cache
steps.hint: The same seal. The same supplies. Take the Reed upstairs.
Take the Quartz, then approach the beacon housing.
Use the housing to fit the shutters and Quartz. This uses 3 Reed and 1 Quartz.
steps.voice: Caldus, below: The bell! They're nearly on the rocks!

steps.objective: Light the beacon with your Torch
steps.hint: Use your crafted Torch. The boat is waiting for your light.

steps.objective: Take the return stair to the dock
steps.hint: The eastern shortcut is open. Follow it down to the saved boat.
steps.voice: Nesh: This seal was cut, not broken by the storm. We'll show Ilyon.

steps.hint: The galley pays 10 gold for this meat. Sell once at Caldus's counter.
steps.voice: Caldus: Fresh meat for the galley? Take bread for the crossing.

steps.hint: Bread costs 8 gold, leaving you 2. This is a normal NPC trade, without another player.

steps.objective: Board the boat to Four Gates
steps.hint: Choose Ready for Four Gates, or take one more look. The beacon will stay lit.
steps.voice: Caldus: You got them home. Come on. The road is yours.

notes: The prototype simulates UI, combat and XP. Production World handlers are not connected.
Bread's 8-gold price and the Torch recipe match current server content. Meat's 10-gold galley sale is a one-time quest offer.
The handoff ends at a preview card; this draft never writes a live character or changes a server map.
